notes.title: AI-Powered Detective Game Sherlock Holmes: Night Stalker Shines at Gamescom 2025
notes.notes: [p]     At the recently concluded Gamescom 2025, the world’s largest gaming event, the highly anticipated AI-driven interactive detective game <Sherlock Holmes: Night Stalker> made its debut in the TOC showcase area. As the only title at this year’s event built entirely around artificial intelligence technology, it quickly became a centerpiece of attention, drawing crowds of journalists, industry experts, and popular gaming streamers.[/p][p][/p][p][i][b]Media Spotlight and Critical Praise[/b][/i][/p][p]    Throughout the show, major German broadcasters RTL and NTV featured the game in dedicated reports, calling it “a new era for detective games.” Game critic Bartosz Kwidziński described it as “a must-see indie gem at Cologne, blending AI innovation with a legendary IP.” Several well-known streamers also played the demo live and praised the game enthusiastically.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592970/e6840e1e5030dfc895333a1e4eecfea510a06e00.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i][b]Unprecedented Playtest Frenzy[/b][/i][/p][p]    Queues stretched long at the booth, with eager fans waiting hours for a chance to experience the game. Most playtesters stayed engaged for more than 15 minutes, while diehard fans immersed themselves for up to three hours. Player feedback collected onsite repeatedly featured words like “Amazing,” “Interesting,” and “Love this game.”[/p][p]    The game’s standout feature—the FREE CHAT system—was especially well received. NPCs respond intelligently in line with their original character traits, complete with real-time facial expressions and voice acting. When players stumble upon key clues, NPCs “unlock” new revelations, advancing the story in unexpected directions. This innovation left players thrilled.[/p][p]    The art direction also earned widespread admiration. With its Victorian-era architecture, Baroque-style interiors, and sunlit countryside vistas, the game world immerses players in a richly atmospheric setting. Attention to detail is meticulous—cobwebs in corners, eerie portraits, flickering candles, and the punctual chime of a grandfather clock all serve as potential clues. Hundreds of in-game objects can act as evidence or be gifted to NPCs to unlock new dialogue paths, adding layers of freedom and surprise to the experience.[/p][p]    Notably, many visitors chose to play in small groups of 3–5, taking turns “interrogating” NPCs. Sessions often erupted in laughter or deep contemplation, showcasing both the game’s social appeal and narrative depth.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592970/8368e356aa4c5b1731f2be4a4304bad51b01121c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i][b]Looking Ahead[/b][/i][/p][p]    The success at Gamescom highlighted the enormous potential for AI-powered games in Western markets, with the FREE CHAT mechanic emerging as a clear favorite among players. The development team revealed they had gathered a wealth of feedback, much of which will be implemented in upcoming updates.[/p][p]    Next, <Sherlock Holmes: Night Stalker> will appear at the Steam Next Fest, where it will be tested by a broader global audience. The team promises to continue refining the experience, aiming to deliver an even more polished and immersive detective adventure at launch.[/p][p][/p]
